content.short: Yoroi is a light wallet for Cardano. It’s simple, fast and secure. Made by EMURGO.
content.description: Yoroi is a light wallet for Cardano. It’s simple, fast and secure. Yoroi is an Emurgo product, engineered by IOHK. And it follows best practices for software in the industry including a comprehensive security audit. Daedalus and Yoroi are complements to what they try to achieve. Yoroi looks to be a day to day wallet for a Cardano user. EMURGO drives the adoption of Cardano and adds value to ADA holders by building, investing in, and advising projects or organizations that adopt Cardano’s decentralized blockchain ecosystem. Yoroi is a light wallet for Cardano.
content.meta: Find out about Yoroi Wallet (Yoroi) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
